The Transformers path is chosen because it is the only one the card pins version by version. MIT is a copyright grant only, not patent freedom to operate. shard_size_hint 25 and per_page_timeout_seconds 900 are conservative: there is no TAVONEL speed measurement for this model, and the canary sets both. max_concurrency_per_worker stays 1 until the canary raises it. Framework-floor audit (2026-09-03, after the GLM-OCR canary died on an unrecognised model_type): the required framework floor, what the pinned base image actually ships, the action taken and the evidence URLs are recorded in provenance.json under framework_floor_audit. bootstrap.sh asserts the pinned framework versions and that the framework recognises this checkpoint's architecture before anything starts.
